content.title: NYC Half Marathon street closures on Sunday
content.text: TRAFFICWatch live streaming coverage of the 2026 United Airlines NYC Half on Sunday, March 15, starting at 7 a.m.ByEyewitness News Stream New York's #1 news - AccuWeather - original content 24/7NEW YORK (WABC) -- Many streets in Brooklyn and Manhattan will be closed on Sunday for the 2026 United Airlines New York City Half.ABC 7 New York is a proud sponsor of the United Airlines NYC Half. You will be able to watch live streaming coverage of the event on abc7NY.com, our mobile and connected TV apps, and social media platforms on Sunday, March 15, starting at 7 a.m.The Half will also be covered during Eyewitness News Sunday Morning on Channel 7 with live updates between 6 a.m. to 10 a.m. Additionally, the four professional fields will be covered by a livestream, available on ESPN+ and NYRR's digital channels beginning at 7 a.m. EST.Organized by the New York Road Runners, the United Airlines NYC Half is the world's premier half marathon and the largest in the U.S.The following streets will be closed Sunday for the marathon event at the discretion of the NYPD in Brooklyn and Manhattan.Brooklyn (Main Route):Start: Washington Avenue near Sullivan PlaceWashington Avenue between
